lines.text: After Jesus drives out a mute demon, some say He does it by Beelzebul, prince of the demons.
Others demand a sign from heaven, and Jesus says every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste.
Jesus says their sons will be their servants, and by God's finger, the kingdom of God has come.
Jesus calls the generation wicked and says only the sign of Jonah will be given, a sign to the Ninevites.
The Queen of the South came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of David.
